summary_en: Oral zelenirstat (also called PCLX-001) is being tested in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML). It is taken by mouth once daily at the same time each day, in 28-day cycles, at dose levels from 40 mg to 280 mg daily, and the number of cycles is not stated. This is a Phase 1 dose-finding study with dose escalation and dose expansion parts; the main outcome is not stated, but each dose level is checked for dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) before moving to the next.
summary_es: Se está probando zelenirstat por vía oral (también llamado PCLX-001) en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria. Se toma por vía oral una vez al día, a la misma hora cada día, en ciclos de 28 días, con niveles de dosis de 40 mg a 280 mg diarios; el número de ciclos no está indicado. Es un estudio de fase 1 para encontrar la dosis, con partes de escalada y expansión de dosis; el resultado principal no está indicado, pero en cada nivel de dosis se revisa la toxicidad limitante de dosis (DLT) antes de pasar al siguiente.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
Relapsed or refractory AML, after at least one prior AML therapy
Not eligible for other therapies expected to give clinical benefit
Adequate liver, kidney, and heart function, based on the listed tests
not_for: Known allergy or hypersensitivity to the study drug or its ingredients
Significant heart disease, such as NYHA class above II, unstable angina, recent heart attack, or uncontrolled arrhythmia
Moderate or severe liver impairment (Child-Pugh class B or C)
Breastfeeding during the study or until 4 months after the last dose
